raw_affiliation_strings: Raymond F. Hopkins is Professor of Political Science and Director of Public Policy at Swarthmore College. An author of books and article on international politics and food policy, he was held visiting, teaching, or research appointments at Columbia, Harvard, Pennsylvania, Princeton, and Stanford universities. He has been a Guggenheim Fellow, a Fellow of the Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars, and a Rockefeller Fellow. Since 1985 he has served as a consultant on international food issues to the Agency for international Development, the Canadian International Development Agency, the World Bank, and the World Food Program
